_header: FIRST-PASS RATCHET — the BEST first-pass rate each exam has ever recorded. `npm run first-pass:check` recomputes the current rate from the committed packets and REFUSES when it is lower, unless a `reasons` row names the decrease with matching from/to. Raised automatically by `--write-receipt`; lowered ONLY through a reasons row. A metric that can quietly fall is not a metric.
